The '''Krinemonen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] that contained the planet [[Krinemonen]] and its habitable moon [[Krinemonen III]]. It was connected to the [[Damendine system/Legends|Damendine]] and [[Hinakuu system/Legends|Hinakuu]] systems by the [[Tidal Circuit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. It was also connected to the [[Buchich system/Legends|Buchich system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
One of the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] orbited the moon Krinemonen III.<ref name="G8">{{GamerCite|8|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin}}</ref>

The system was destroyed by the [[Galaxy Gun]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref>
